content.text: ▪︎dilate & impaired contract of LV or both ventricles

▪︎cardiomyopathy: altered ♡ struct · impaired myocard funct · dysfun electrical properties w.o CAD & HTN - primary (genetic) vs 2ndry (illness · toxins · infect) - dilated · hypertrophic · restrictive · ARVC · unclassified
▪︎major cause of HF & ♡ transplant in US
▪︎takotsubo (stress-induced) · Chagas (Trypanosoma cruzi protozoa = leading cause of DCM in Central & South America) · Lyme dz · chronic ETOH
· fatigue · periph edema · pulm congestion · cough · hepatomeg
: Lt ventricular dilate · thin ventricular walls · ↓LVEF · ventricular hypokinesis
▪︎dilate & impaired contract of both ventricles - 4 dilated chambers (ventricles > atria)
: may show sinus tachy or arrhythmias
▪︎refractory to max medical therapy: ♡ transplant or LV assist device (⍉transplant candidates)
ddx arrhythmogenic RV cardiomyopathy (ARVC): RV free wall replaced by fibrofatty tissue · RV dyskinesis - less common genetic CM
▪︎avg age @ dx 30-40yo - septum USU thicker than free wall
▪︎struct CV dz (incl HCM) = MCC SCD in athletes <35yo - nonischemic cardiomyopathies = 2nd MCC SCD in US
hypertrophy & systol anterior motion of MV
▪︎syncope or sudden death during exertion - may present as sudden death in young athlete
– syncope USU during or immediately after exercise
+/- loud S4 · MR or pulsus biferiens
: asym ventricular wall thickness (esp. septal) · systol anterior motion of MV · sm LV chamber size
DX: ECHO or ♡ MRI + genetic testing
▪︎≈90% have EKG abnormalities: LVH · deep narrow Q waves (precordial · inferior & lateral) · T wave inversion · LAE · repolarization chgs · large-amplitude QRS
*pts should ⍉dehydration, extreme exertion, & exercise; cautious use of digoxin, nitrates, & diuretics
Admit + cardio: angina · near-syncope · syncope · dysrhythmias
▪︎refrain from vigorous activity until cardio eval
▪︎Sxtomatic: BBs · NDHP CCBs · myosin inhibitors (2nd line)
ventricle → ⍉ventricular filling (↓compliance) - stiff ventricle fills w great effort
▪︎much less common than DCM & HCM - also scleroderma
: ⍉dilated ventricles w norm thickness · diastol dysfun · marked dilate of both atria
